description: This file defines a class 'ImmutablePolicyBuilderLabelScoped' which is a builder for creating immutable 'Policy' objects scoped to specific labels, providing a fluent API for policy configuration within a Java project related to the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicyBuilderLabelScoped
classes.description: A mutable builder for an immutable Policy object, scoped to a Label, providing methods to set various policy attributes in a fluent way.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the builder scoped to a specific Label.

methods.name: forLabel
methods.description: Returns a new builder instance scoped to a different Label.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the Label associated with this builder.

methods.name: exitLabel
methods.description: Returns the parent PolicyBuilder, exiting the label scope.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the PolicyId for the policy being built.

methods.name: setLifecycle
methods.description: Sets the lifecycle attribute of the policy.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Sets the revision of the policy.

methods.name: setModified
methods.description: Sets the last modified timestamp.

methods.name: setCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Adds a PolicyEntry to the policy.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Adds multiple PolicyEntries to the policy.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a PolicyEntry by label.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a PolicyEntry.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes multiple PolicyEntries.

methods.name: setSubjectsFor
methods.description: Associates Subjects with a specific label.

methods.name: setSubjectFor
methods.description: Associates a Subject with a specific label.

methods.name: removeSubjectFor
methods.description: Removes a Subject association from a label.

methods.name: removeSubjectFor
methods.description: Removes a Subject.

methods.name: setResourcesFor
methods.description: Sets Resources for a given label.

methods.name: setResourceFor
methods.description: Sets a Resource for a label.

methods.name: removeResourceFor
methods.description: Removes a Resource for a label by ResourceKey.

methods.name: removeResourceFor
methods.description: Removes a Resource from a label.

methods.name: setPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets EffectedPermissions for a resource under a label.

methods.name: setGrantedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Grants specific permissions for a resource under a label.

methods.name: setGrantedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Grants specific permissions for a resource under a label with multiple permissions.

methods.name: setRevokedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Revokes specific permissions for a resource under a label.

methods.name: setRevokedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Revokes specific permissions for a resource under a label with multiple permissions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns the current immutable Policy object.
